pillar_reactions.evidence: Delivered from 00:25:21, framed around injury prevention for basketball and windsurfing. The prospect volunteered agreement and tied it straight back to his own reason for being there: 'Yeah, yeah, that's why I want this.' He had already pre-sold himself on the modality earlier in the call — 'I like this kettlebell training. I don't like to go to gym... I want full body and I want to training this at home' — and he already owns 16 kg bells.

Delivered at 00:27:51 as what you eat, when you eat, how much you eat, with the rep conceding his nutrition is largely handled already — 'in your case, it sounds it's already... Probably maybe it needs some adjustments, like little tweaks.' The prospect agreed without questions ('Yeah? Okay. yes'). No enthusiasm and no pushback; he already tracks intake himself through ChatGPT and considers this solved.

Delivered at 00:28:41 and deliberately anchored to something the prospect had said himself twenty minutes earlier about personal trainers holding him to a time. He acknowledged it ('Okay') and later reinforced the underlying need — 'I go on next level to somebody teach me is much better than I'm teaching by myself.' Understood and agreed, but he asked nothing about how the accountability actually works, which is notable given how hard he later interrogated the app.

anchors.raw: I have before many personal trainers, very good guys... when they work in gym, we were training together. It was, I don't know, maybe six, seven years ago... was like one-on-one and it was good. I was at that time in amazing shape.
anchors.note: He has a settled habit of paying for one-on-one coaching and remembers it working. No price was ever attached to it, so it functions as a value precedent rather than a number to beat. The rep used it correctly, converting the memory into the accountability pillar.

anchors.raw: especially if I'm paying $6,000 or $9,000, it doesn't matter
anchors.note: The prospect repeats both list prices back unprompted, in the middle of an objection, purely to justify wanting proof. Nothing in his head competes with $6,000 on price — he owns three factories and five mines and mentions a yacht in passing. The blocker was evidence, not cost, and any money play run here would have been aimed at the wrong target.

unmet_demand.want: To see the training app before paying — a demo, a video, or at minimum a screenshot of an empty menu
unmet_demand.why_unmet: The company appears to have no shareable or anonymised view of the product. The rep checked with the team live and came back with 'we don't have this video of the app because, like, we cannot share the client's details', then 'I any screenshots, nothing how it looks like' / 'I wish I had, yeah, but I don't.' The app plainly exists and is demonstrable — he screen-shared a client's version of it later the same day — so this is an asset and permissions problem, not a product limitation.

unmet_demand.want: Sport-specific preparation periodised to a competition calendar — the Croatian championship on 25 June and a Masters podium the following season
unmet_demand.why_unmet: The offer as presented is a general kettlebell strength, conditioning and mobility programme delivered in three-to-four 30-40 minute sessions a week. The rep promised the plan would be built around his schedule and life, but nothing was said about peaking, tapering or training around a race calendar, and he did not ask whether Trevor programmes for competing athletes. The prospect's single most important goal is therefore unaddressed on the record.

unmet_demand.want: Confirmation that a 50-year-old is a normal client for this programme
unmet_demand.why_unmet: Not a gap in the product, but the reassurance was never given here. He raised age indirectly through his 65-68 year old training partners and the rep answered with flattery ('Most of the guys that I talk to, when they are 51 or even over 60, they're not as crazy as you') rather than evidence. In the separate Marian Samson call the same rep does give this proof point directly. Recording it because it is the second prospect in two days to probe age fit.
